messages:
lina_sales: FYI Evelyn from Acme hitting 403 on /v1/generate during the live PoC. Error text says project claim mismatch. Can infra triage?

evelyn_acme: "403 Forbidden: project claim does not match request". Using key copied from the portal and header X-Redwood-Project: acme-production.

lina_sales: can you paste the curl you ran (mask the key)?

evelyn_acme: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk.test.ABCD" -H "X-Redwood-Project: acme-production" -d '{"model":"redwood-medium","input":"hello"}'

carla_se: quick note: project binding on keys is case-sensitive. Presales flow sometimes creates a temp project name (acme-poc-<id>).

omar_infra: looked at auth logs: bound_project=acme-poc-734 header=acme-production decision=DENY (project mismatch).

jordan_support: temporary workaround: call with X-Redwood-Project: acme-poc-734 or we can rebind the key to acme-production. Which is easier for you?

evelyn_acme: rebind please, customers don't want to change demo scripts mid-call. Also saw sporadic 429s earlier during load test  any link between key binding and rate limit?

omar_infra: separate issues. 429s were free-trial throttle (60rpm) and your traffic spiked to ~110rpm with parallel requests. We can apply a temporary uplift for the demo window.

carla_se: I'll approve a one-off demo uplift and rebind the key. Plan: 1) rebind existing key to acme-production, 2) uplift quota to 300rpm for 3 hours, 3) provide audit trail and security blurb.

ops_bot: Rebind action recorded: act_20421 by omar_infra at 2025-09-15T16:12:40Z. Quota uplift (300rpm) applied until 2025-09-15T19:12:40Z.

evelyn_acme: confirmed post-rebind calls succeed with acme-production header and streaming 200s. Thanks! Please send audit log and a pricing ballpark for sustained 10 qps.

jordan_support: pricing ballpark: hosted API per-token + throughput guidance; for steady 10 qps on redwood-medium expect ~USD 7k-10k/month depending on token sizes and caching. We'll route to sales for exact quote.

lina_sales: I'll follow up with a formal quote and the security docs. Closing the swarm unless anything else. :thumbsup:
